Gamma scan report GS001, C201 Depropaniser, scanned 2026-01-15.
Scope: trays 1 to 45, single scan line.
Findings: all trays show froth heights within the expected band for the current vapour rate. No missing tray signatures, no flooding. Some trays in the stripping section show periodically reduced froth density, consistent with intermittent low vapour rates rather than mechanical damage.
Interpretation: tray hardware intact. Investigate vapour supply stability from the reboiler.

Gamma scan report GS003, C301 Deethaniser, scanned 2026-03-28 at 37 t/h feed.
Scope: full height, two scan lines at 90 degrees, trays 1 to 40.
Findings: trays 4 to 8 in the top section show low froth density and liquid build up on the tray below, consistent with liquid bypassing the active area. Trays 6 and 7 show no froth signature on one scan line, indicating missing or displaced panels. Remaining trays show normal froth heights and clear vapour spaces. No flooding signature.
Interpretation: mechanical damage consistent with an upward pressure surge. Expect reduced turndown and efficiency in the top section.
Recommendation: plan internal inspection and repair at the earliest outage. Until then avoid low vapour rates.
